ideas.title: Mammoth Cave tours
ideas.note: Pick two: Historic Tour plus Domes and Dripstones, or the lantern-lit Violet City tour. Reserve on Recreation.gov.

ideas.title: Hidden River Cave and American Cave Museum
ideas.note: One ticket covers both, in Horse Cave. Check current hours and prices.

ideas.title: National Corvette Museum
ideas.note: 2012 did the museum and the assembly-plant tour.

ideas.title: Pre-Derby race day at Churchill Downs
ideas.note: Wed May 3, 2028. In 2026 the Wednesday of Derby week was 'Winsday'. 2012 did the same with a Derby Museum tour.

ideas.title: Great Steamboat Race
ideas.note: Ran the Wednesday before the Derby in 2026; that would be the same day as our race day. Date inferred.

ideas.title: Bernheim Forest
ideas.note: Giant troll sculptures and a treetop canopy walk, about 15 minutes from the Shepherdsville campgrounds.

ideas.title: Louisville Slugger Museum and lunch cruise
Buffalo Trace Distillery, Trace Tour
ideas.note: Free, 75 minutes, the only accessible tour. Email for ~50 people in four groups of 12-13. Trucks only; carpool. 2012 toured it too.

ideas.title: Derby Day at Keeneland
ideas.note: Sat May 6, 2028, about 30 minutes from Frankfort. Colleen's call for cost; 2012 did the same.

ideas.title: Kentucky History Center and Old State Capitol
ideas.note: One ticket covers both plus the Military History Museum. The new Capitol's interior is closed for renovation until about Jan 2029.

ideas.title: Working horse-farm tours
ideas.note: Booked through Horse Country, Inc. (e.g., Claiborne, Lane's End). Group tours ran about $20 in 2020.

ideas.title: Kentucky Horse Park museum and Hall of Champions
Camp Nelson National Monument
ideas.note: Civil War camp where many Black Union soldiers enlisted. Check May hours (daily hours began Memorial Day in 2024).

ideas.title: Kentucky Artisan Center and Berea galleries
Renfro Valley shows
ideas.note: The center still books concerts (2026 lineup online); check the week of May 13-21, 2028.

ideas.title: Farewell banquet
ideas.note: Options: Renfro Valley KOA pavilion, Fort Boonesborough activities building (seats 150), or Boone Tavern as in 2012.
